features.quote: Early termination (rare): If the agent calls a tool that is not finish for 3 consecutive steps... the run ends to prevent infinite loops.
features.justification_quote: the run ends to prevent infinite loops

features.quote: Include a hard timeout (30s per tool call, 10 min per run) and a kill switch in the harness.
This gives you a concrete, measurable, and morally bounded eval.
